description: An invariant certificate checked, and consecution as a query whose counterexample the kernel checks.

result.text:
; Consecution: sat exactly where the invariant holds of a state and fails after one step.
; A model is a counterexample to induction for the kernel to check; unsat is not a verdict.
(set-option :produce-models true)
(set-logic ALL)

; Records and variants.
; JSON values: a record is a chain of fields.
(declare-datatypes ((|json:Json| 0) (|json:Fields| 0)) (((|json:null|) (|json:bool| (|json:bool.v| Bool)) (|json:number| (|json:number.v| Float64)) (|json:string| (|json:string.v| String)) (|json:list| (|json:list.v| (Seq |json:Json|))) (|json:record| (|json:record.v| |json:Fields|))) ((|json:end|) (|json:field| (|json:field.key| String) (|json:field.value| |json:Json|) (|json:field.rest| |json:Fields|)))))
; Whether a record has a field, and its value (null if it has none).
(define-funs-rec ((|json:has| ((f |json:Fields|) (k String)) Bool) (|json:get| ((f |json:Fields|) (k String)) |json:Json|)) ((ite ((_ is |json:field|) f) (or (= (|json:field.key| f) k) (|json:has| (|json:field.rest| f) k)) false) (ite ((_ is |json:field|) f) (ite (= (|json:field.key| f) k) (|json:field.value| f) (|json:get| (|json:field.rest| f) k)) |json:null|)))
; Whether a term is a value the kernel could hold: finite numbers, and each record's keys once.
(define-funs-rec ((|json:ok| ((j |json:Json|)) Bool) (|json:ok.items| ((s (Seq |json:Json|))) Bool) (|json:ok.fields| ((f |json:Fields|)) Bool)) ((and (ite ((_ is |json:number|) j) (not (or (fp.isNaN (|json:number.v| j)) (fp.isInfinite (|json:number.v| j)))) true) (ite ((_ is |json:list|) j) (|json:ok.items| (|json:list.v| j)) true) (ite ((_ is |json:record|) j) (|json:ok.fields| (|json:record.v| j)) true)) (ite (= (seq.len s) 0) true (and (|json:ok| (seq.nth s 0)) (|json:ok.items| (seq.extract s 1 (- (seq.len s) 1))))) (ite ((_ is |json:field|) f) (and (|json:ok| (|json:field.value| f)) (not (|json:has| (|json:field.rest| f) (|json:field.key| f))) (|json:ok.fields| (|json:field.rest| f))) true)))
; {n: Int}
(declare-datatype |record:d1a0623e| ((|record:d1a0623e| (|record:d1a0623e.n| Int))))
; A variant with the cases cancelled, child, world.
(declare-datatype |variant:7ec60edd| ((|variant:7ec60edd#cancelled|) (|variant:7ec60edd#child| (|variant:7ec60edd#child.error| |json:Json|)) (|variant:7ec60edd#world| (|variant:7ec60edd#world.detail| |json:Json|))))
; A variant with the cases count, spawn.
(declare-datatype |variant:96902820| ((|variant:96902820#count| (|variant:96902820#count.call| Int) (|variant:96902820#count.value| Int)) (|variant:96902820#spawn| (|variant:96902820#spawn.call| Int) (|variant:96902820#spawn.value| |json:Json|))))
; {}
(declare-datatype |record:49d8b93e| ((|record:49d8b93e|)))
; A variant with the cases failed, refused, ret, start.
(declare-datatype |variant:5e4106e1| ((|variant:5e4106e1#failed| (|variant:5e4106e1#failed.call| Int) (|variant:5e4106e1#failed.error| |variant:7ec60edd|) (|variant:5e4106e1#failed.op| String)) (|variant:5e4106e1#refused| (|variant:5e4106e1#refused.call| Int) (|variant:5e4106e1#refused.op| String)) (|variant:5e4106e1#ret| (|variant:5e4106e1#ret.| |variant:96902820|)) (|variant:5e4106e1#start| (|variant:5e4106e1#start.value| |record:49d8b93e|))))
; {call: Int, value: Int}
(declare-datatype |record:1fc44c8e| ((|record:1fc44c8e| (|record:1fc44c8e.call| Int) (|record:1fc44c8e.value| Int))))

; Definitions.
; The invariant, of a state.
(define-fun |def:invariant| ((|v:state| |record:d1a0623e|)) Bool (>= (|record:d1a0623e.n| |v:state|) 0))
; The state the step gives.
(define-fun |def:next| ((|v:state| |record:d1a0623e|) (|v:input| |variant:5e4106e1|)) |record:d1a0623e| (let ((|c:1| |v:input|)) (ite ((_ is |variant:5e4106e1#failed|) |c:1|) |v:state| (ite ((_ is |variant:5e4106e1#refused|) |c:1|) |v:state| (ite ((_ is |variant:5e4106e1#ret|) |c:1|) (let ((|v:r| (|variant:5e4106e1#ret.| |c:1|))) (let ((|c:2| |v:r|)) (ite ((_ is |variant:96902820#count|) |c:2|) (let ((|v:c| (|record:1fc44c8e| (|variant:96902820#count.call| |c:2|) (|variant:96902820#count.value| |c:2|)))) (|record:d1a0623e| (+ (|record:d1a0623e.n| |v:state|) (|record:1fc44c8e.value| |v:c|)))) |v:state|))) |v:state|)))))
; Where the kernel evaluates next without an error; elsewhere the function above is unconstrained.
(define-fun |defined:next| ((|v:state| |record:d1a0623e|) (|v:input| |variant:5e4106e1|)) Bool (let ((|c:1| |v:input|)) (let ((|v:r| (|variant:5e4106e1#ret.| |c:1|))) (let ((|c:2| |v:r|)) (let ((|v:c| (|record:1fc44c8e| (|variant:96902820#count.call| |c:2|) (|variant:96902820#count.value| |c:2|)))) (=> (and ((_ is |variant:5e4106e1#ret|) |c:1|) ((_ is |variant:96902820#count|) |c:2|)) (and (<= (- 9007199254740991) (+ (|record:d1a0623e.n| |v:state|) (|record:1fc44c8e.value| |v:c|))) (<= (+ (|record:d1a0623e.n| |v:state|) (|record:1fc44c8e.value| |v:c|)) 9007199254740991))))))))

; A counterexample to induction.
(declare-const |q:state| |record:d1a0623e|)
(declare-const |q:input| |variant:5e4106e1|)
(assert (and (=> ((_ is |variant:5e4106e1#failed|) |q:input|) (and (=> ((_ is |variant:7ec60edd#child|) (|variant:5e4106e1#failed.error| |q:input|)) (|json:ok| (|variant:7ec60edd#child.error| (|variant:5e4106e1#failed.error| |q:input|)))) (=> ((_ is |variant:7ec60edd#world|) (|variant:5e4106e1#failed.error| |q:input|)) (|json:ok| (|variant:7ec60edd#world.detail| (|variant:5e4106e1#failed.error| |q:input|)))))) (=> ((_ is |variant:5e4106e1#ret|) |q:input|) (=> ((_ is |variant:96902820#spawn|) (|variant:5e4106e1#ret.| |q:input|)) (|json:ok| (|variant:96902820#spawn.value| (|variant:5e4106e1#ret.| |q:input|)))))))
(assert (|def:invariant| |q:state|))
(assert (|defined:next| |q:state| |q:input|))
(assert (not (|def:invariant| (|def:next| |q:state| |q:input|))))
(check-sat)
(get-value (|q:state| |q:input|))
